model_output.evidence_id_choices: candidate paragraph IDs present in that stimulus plus none; the evidence question is independent of the window-status answer
model_output.not_checked: derived from the absence of a program or apply page; never sent to TypeSafe
model_output.unknown_rule: No candidate means no update and human review; absence from the candidate list alone never means not_stated. For not_stated or unclear, ignore the independent evidence answer and do not export its candidate text or URL.
model_output.positive_evidence_rule: fixed_dates or rolling must select a candidate paragraph ID from the exact input. Code copies its paragraph and source URL from the frozen fixture.

acceptance.natural_page_accuracy: At least 22 of 24 exact status matches; report coverage and abstentions separately.
acceptance.baseline_comparison: No more than one additional error versus the independent current-agent extraction on the same 24 page cases.
acceptance.not_stated_false_positives: Zero fixed_dates or rolling predictions on gold not_stated cases.
acceptance.not_checked_controls: All 8 controls make no API request and remain not_checked.
acceptance.challenge_cases: All 8 exact labels; instruction-like page text, negation, old dates, fixed/rolling overlap, misleading dates, and irrelevant context are included.
acceptance.option_order: All 8 repeated inputs return the same window_status choice after reversing criteria key order.
acceptance.provenance: Every fixed_dates or rolling answer has a valid input candidate ID, and its copied paragraph and source URL match the frozen fixture byte-for-byte.
acceptance.human_review_time: Unknown; no human timing study is in scope. Do not claim integration ROI.
acceptance.cost_and_latency: Record actual usage tokens, a published-price estimate from actual usage (not invoice), per-request client wall time, and total run time. Do not infer cost or provider-reported model latency from documentation.

safety.resume_duplicate_policy: Never retry an attempt ID already present in the durable intent journal. Continue only with never-attempted IDs, within the remaining total cap.
